_comment: Core System Rules - Universal game mechanics that NEVER change across missions
_override_policy: NEVER - These rules are immutable game mechanics

u_boat_damage_chart.label: U-Boat Damage Chart
u_boat_damage_chart.description: Apply when U-Boat takes damage from depth charges, surface fire, or aircraft attacks

outcomes.effect: Add 1 Hull damage marker (cannot be repaired)
Roll 3d6: tubes matching 1-5 are damaged (ignore 6s and duplicates)
Roll twice on General Damage table
Add 1 Hull damage marker (cannot be repaired)
Mark flak gun as damaged. Cannot use until repaired (Surfaced only)
Roll 2d6: tubes matching 1-5 are damaged (ignore 6s and duplicates). Loaded tubes become unloaded.
Mark engine as damaged. Roll 2d6 for AP instead of 3d6. Easier to detect (detection -1)
Mark deck gun as damaged. Cannot use until repaired (Surfaced only)

crew_kia_system.procedure: Roll 1d6 to determine crew member (1-6 as numbered on mission map)

medic_save.condition: If Medic alive and not the target

notes: No effect if crew member already KIA
If Medic dead, all hits are automatic KIA

forced_ascent.trigger: Hull damage taken while deeper than permitted
forced_ascent.effect: Immediately ascend to deepest permitted depth
forced_ascent.cost: No AP cost, no DL change
forced_ascent.destruction_condition: If ship blocks required ascent, U-Boat destroyed

allied_ship_damage_chart.label: Allied Ship Damage Chart
allied_ship_damage_chart.description: For each Torpedo / Deck Gun Hit on a Ship, roll d6
notes: A ship already Damaged that takes another hit is Sunk
Catastrophic hits sink the ship immediately regardless of prior state

forced_dive_mechanics.label: Forced Dive
forced_dive_mechanics.trigger: Ship enters same hex as U-Boat when U-Boat is Surfaced or at Periscope depth

movement_rules.u_boat_entering_ship_hex: U-Boat can only enter ship hex at Medium or Deep depth
movement_rules.ship_entering_u_boat_hex: If ship enters U-Boat hex when U-Boat is Surfaced/Periscope, triggers forced dive

effects.effect: Immediately set U-Boat depth to MEDIUM
U-Boat suffers -2 AP penalty next turn

shallow_water_exception.condition: Forced dive occurs in shallow water hex
shallow_water_exception.effect: U-Boat destroyed (cannot dive to Medium in shallow water)

hull_damage_exception.condition: Forced dive occurs when U-Boat has 2+ hull damage
hull_damage_exception.effect: U-Boat destroyed (cannot dive to Medium with hull damage restrictions)
hull_damage_exception.note: Hull damage level 2 restricts max depth to Periscope

hex_occupancy_rules.label: Hex Occupancy Rules
hex_occupancy_rules.ships: Only one ship per hex (ships cannot stack)
hex_occupancy_rules.u_boat_and_ship: U-Boat can share hex with ship ONLY at Medium or Deep depth
hex_occupancy_rules.aircraft: Any number of aircraft can share hex with ships and/or U-Boat

line_of_sight_rules.label: Line of Sight

range_2.diagonal: LOS along edge between 2 hexes (favor observer if one is land)

range_3.rule: LOS through exactly 2 intervening hexes. Both must be non-land.

line_of_sight_rules.reciprocal: If A can see B, then B can see A

repair_system.label: Repair System
notes: Damaged torpedo tubes become unloaded and must be reloaded after repair
Each repair action fixes 1 damage marker OR up to 2 torpedo tubes
